definitions.correct: True means the present field source or rule agrees with the proposed meaning. False also covers missing autofill, stale snapshots, unverified presets and editor versus output mismatch. This does not approve legal terms.
definitions.confidence: Sure for explicit field meaning or arithmetic. Likely for proposed assignment and source links not implemented today. Unclear only for the five listed genuine alternative meanings.
definitions.missingMasterData: No verified authoritative structured source or link for this fact was found. It can exist as text or another saved document. This is not a claim about real user data.
definitions.pathNotation: [] represents a repeating row; {shootDay} represents a dynamic day key. computed names describe printed projections, not new stored keys. Proposed subject IDs and document links are not claimed to exist today.

commonRules: Budget, Contacts, funding and ledgers are each one master pool. Saved document data at mbtdb_<template>_<project> is a document snapshot or an intentional user override, not another master pool.

Select a real document subject and retain stable IDs. Do not turn an arbitrary first crew item into the signer, vendor or performer. Role matching should use exact aliases plus department classification across all parts. Missing identity or legal authority is not an AI inference.

Use a shared projection for default load, Load from Budget and AI Fill. Mark derived values separately from explicit overrides. Preview changes when the master changes. Current populated snapshot values are not refreshed automatically.

Money is held in its source currency. Use the active budget exchangeRateState table and explicit document currency to convert exactly once. A missing exchange rate is an error, not parity. Never use a float advance and its receipts as two expenses.
Dates are local production calendar dates. A planned shoot count is not a working calendar, performer guarantee or property rental period. Clock times need the production timezone.

AI can draft prose from identified script, treatment and master facts. It must not invent names, signatures, approvals, union coverage, medical facts or contractual rights. Bind any response to the original project and template before applying it.

Legal and safety fields describe information to record, not legal advice or an approved agreement. Existing generic terms must be reviewed and agreed; blank input is preferable to a fabricated obligation.
missingData: A designated enquiry contact ID, lead creative assignment and explicit primary producer are not established by a first role substring match.

Structured per person employment terms, legal versus stage identity, agent relationships, authority to sign, age consent and negotiated rights are not consistently exposed by Contacts. Existing optional metadata may be retained, but must not be guessed.

A canonical structured shooting calendar, scene breakdown, cast work status, actual production day log, take continuity log, transport schedule and location permissions are not wired to these fields. Saved mBTDB documents can supply approved facts through proposed document links.

PO Paid status and paidAmount exist. A full dated allocation of PO commitments to accrued item actuals is not supplied by one item.actualDate and aggregate PO.amount. Explicit ETC forecasts are also missing.
Petty cash physical counts, reconciliations, signatures and approval evidence have no verified master link to these editor fields.

Supplier invoice detail, due dates, tax identifiers, equipment serial inventory, replacement values, confirmed equipment return, verified weather and emergency facility suitability are not implied by the budget. Use verified document facts.
